# Nuklear

Source: https://github.com/Immediate-Mode-UI/Nuklear

Revision: `161d49e9bb638372e99ba44c719bd34be35c5636`

`nuklear.h` and `style.h` (upstream `demo/common/style.c`) are unmodified upstream files. Magenta uses Nuklear under the MIT option in LICENSE.

The upstream Catppuccin themes use the Catppuccin palette: https://github.com/catppuccin/palette (revision `07d02aa110ef9eb7e7427afca5c73ba9cf7f8ebd`). Its MIT license is included as CATPPUCCIN-LICENSE.

The layout reference is COSMIC Desktop: https://github.com/pop-os/cosmic-epoch. COSMIC implementation code is not incorporated.
